'''Topaz''' is a gem found in [[Ancient City|ancient city]] chests. It is used to buy [[Topaz Earrings]] from the [[Jeweler]] and is the most valuable of the four gems.

== Obtaining ==
=== Chest loot ===
Topaz is one of the weighted treasures in ancient city chests, alongside [[Crystal Heart]]s and [[Divine Fragment]]s.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/ancient_city.json}}</ref>
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Trading ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Villager !! Level !! Wants !! Gives
|-
| [[Jeweler]] || Expert || 14 × {{ItemLink|Obol}} + {{ItemLink|Topaz}} || {{ItemLink|Topaz Earrings}}
|-
| [[Jeweler]] || Master || {{ItemLink|Topaz}} || 10 × {{ItemLink|Obol}}
|}
<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/5/sell_topaz.json}}</ref>
Topaz can either be turned into [[jewelry]] or sold back to a Master-level Jeweler for 10 [[Obol]]s.

== Advancements ==
Obtaining topaz grants ''Canto IV'' ("Raid Tartarus") in the [[Advancements/Tutorial|Tutorial]] tab, which rewards two [[Crystal Heart]]s. It follows ''Canto III'' and is the last of the four.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/obtain_topaz.json}}</ref>

{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Gems can now be sold to the Jeweler.}}

}}

== Trivia ==
* Like the other gems, topaz is built on a poisonous potato; through 1.12.2 it was built on a fermented spider eye.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/item_modifier/topaz.json}}</ref>
